[SWS_DM_01251] Successful verification of transmitCertificate
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04251
⌈
If the method called in [SWS_DM_01248] executes successfully and returns no error
code, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall return a Positive Response to the
tester. The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall set the parameter authentication-
ReturnParameter (RV) to 0x13 (CertificateVerified) in the positive Response.
